subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` ingest arbitrary JSONL logs, or should raw message logs remain in QMD/session-memory/converter-plugin workflows?
rationale: Current code can be changed mechanically, but the requested source type contains sensitive message data and expands the builtin memory contract beyond documented Markdown/multimodal inputs.

options.title: Require a bounded design first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require an explicit JSONL contract covering allowed sources, redaction/visibility, line addressing, `memory_get`, watcher behavior, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Document existing alternatives
options.body: If arbitrary JSONL is out of scope for builtin memory, document the QMD/session-memory or converter/plugin path and close after that product decision.

options.title: Approve native support now
options.body: Allow a focused implementation across discovery, parsing, indexing, watcher, read, docs, and tests, accepting the expanded core memory surface.

recommendation.title: Require a bounded design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require an explicit JSONL contract covering allowed sources, redaction/visibility, line addressing, `memory_get`, watcher behavior, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already carried the most specific maintainer-side discussion on this issue and has the strongest memory-path history.
